Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ يَسْتَغيثُ الْمُذْنِبُونَ
Translation: O Allah, O the One from whose mercy the sinners seek aid

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ إِلَى ذِكْرِ إِحْسَانِهِ يَفْزَعُ الْمُضْطَرُّونَ
Translation: And O the One to whose remembrance of favors the distressed turn
And O the One before whose fear the wrongdoers weep
O Companion of every lonely stranger
And O Relief of every sorrowful sufferer
And O Aid of every abandoned solitary one
And O Support of every needy outcast

Arabic text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا
Translation: You are the One who encompasses everything with mercy and knowledge

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ جَعَلْتَ لِكُلِّ مَخْلُوقٍ فِيْ نِعَمِكَ سَهْمًا
Translation: And You are the One who has granted every creature a share in Your blessings

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ عَفْوُهُ أَعْلَى مِنْ عِقَابِهِ
Translation: And You are the One whose forgiveness is greater than His punishment

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ تَسْعَى رَحْمَتُهُ أَمَامَ غَضَبِهِ
Translation: And You are the One whose mercy precedes His anger

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ عَطَاؤُهُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ مَنْعِهِ
Translation: And You are the One whose giving is more than His withholding

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ اتَّسَعَ الْخَلَائِقُ كُلُّهُمْ فِيْ وُسْعِهِ
Translation: And You are the One in whose vastness all creation is contained

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ لَا يَرْغَبُ فِيْ جَزَاءِ مَنْ أَعْطَاهُ
Translation: And You are the One who does not desire recompense from those to whom You give

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ لَا يُفْرِطُ فِيْ عِقَابِ مَنْ عَصَاهُ
Translation: And You are the One who does not exceed in punishing those who disobey You

Arabic text: وَأَنَا يَا إِلَهِيْ عَبْدُكَ الَّذِيْ أَمَرْتَهُ بِالدُّعَاءِ
Translation: And I, O my God, am Your servant whom You commanded to supplicate
So I said: Here I am, at Your service and pleasure

Arabic text: هَا أَنَا ذَا يَا رَبِّ مَطْرُوحٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
Translation: Here I am, O Lord, thrown before You
I am the one whose back is burdened with sins
And I am the one whose life is consumed by wrongdoings
And I am the one who, in his ignorance, disobeyed You
Though You did not deserve that from him

Arabic text: هَلْ أَنْتَ يَا إِلَهِيْ رَاحِمٌ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فَأُبْلِغَ فِيْ الدُّعَاءِ
Translation: Will You, O my God, be merciful to one who supplicates to You, so I may persist in supplication?

Arabic text: أَمْ أَنْتَ غَافِرٌ لِمَنْ بَكَاكَ فَأُسْرِعَ فِيْ الْبُكَاءِ
Translation: Or will You forgive one who weeps to You, so I may hasten to weep?

Arabic text: أَمْ أَنْتَ مُتَجَاوِزٌ عَمَّنْ عَفَّرَ لَكَ وَجْهَهُ تَذَلُّلًا
Translation: Or will You overlook one who humbles his face before You?

Arabic text: أَمْ أَنْتَ مُغْنٍ مَنْ شَكَا إِلَيْكَ فَقْرَهُ تَوَكُّلًا
Translation: Or will You enrich one who complains to You of his poverty, trusting in You?

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ لَا تُخَيِّبْ مَنْ لَا يَجِدُ مُعْطِيًا غَيْرَكَ
Translation: My God, do not disappoint one who finds no giver other than You

Arabic text: وَلَا تَخْذُلْ مَنْ لَا يَسْتَغْنِيْ عَنْكَ بِأَحَدٍ دُونَكَ
Translation: And do not forsake one who cannot be free of need for You through anyone else

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: My God, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَلَا تُعْرِضْ عَنِّيْ وَقَدْ أَقْبَلْتُ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: And do not turn away from me when I have turned toward You
And do not deprive me when I have desired You

Arabic text: وَلَا تَجْبَهْنِيْ بِالرَّدِّ وَقَدِ انْتَصَبْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
Translation: And do not reject me with refusal when I have stood before You
You are the One who has described Yourself with mercy

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَارْحَمْنِي
Translation: So bless Muhammad and his family, and have mercy upon me

Arabic text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِيْ سَمَّيْتَ نَفْسَكَ بِالْعَفْوِ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
Translation: And You are the One who has named Yourself with forgiveness, so forgive me

Arabic text: قَدْ تَرَى يَا إِلَهِيْ فَيْضَ دَمْعِيْ مِنْ خِيفَتِكَ
Translation: You see, O my God, the flow of my tears from fear of You
And the pounding of my heart from awe of You
And the trembling of my limbs from dread of You

Arabic text: كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ حَيَاءٌ مِنْكَ لِسُوءِ عَمَلِي
Translation: All of this is out of shame before You for my evil deeds

Arabic text: وَلِذَاكَ خَمَدَ صَوْتِيْ عَنِ الْجَأْرِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And because of this my voice is silenced from crying out to You
And my tongue is unable to whisper to You
O my God, all praise belongs to You

Arabic text: فَكَمْ مِنْ عَائِبَةٍ سَتَرْتَهَا عَلَيَّ فَلَمْ تَفْضَحْنِي
Translation: How many faults You have concealed without exposing me

Arabic text: وَكَمْ مِنْ ذَنْبٍ غَطَّيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْنِي
Translation: How many sins You have covered without disgracing me

Arabic text: وَكَمْ مِنْ شَائِبَةٍ أَلْمَمْتُ بِهَا فَلَمْ تَهْتِكْ عَنِّيْ سِتْرَهَا
Translation: How many blemishes I have committed, yet You did not tear away their covering
And You did not place around my neck the ill of their disgrace

Arabic text: وَلَمْ تُبْدِ سَوْءَاتِهَا لِمَنْ يَلْتَمِسُ مَعَايِبِيْ مِنْ جِيرَتِي
Translation: And You did not reveal my faults to those who seek out my defects among my neighbors
And those who envy Your favor upon me

Arabic text: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْهَنِيْ ذٰلِكَ عَنْ أَنْ جَرَيْتُ إِلَى سُوءِ مَا عَهِدْتَ مِنِّي
Translation: Yet all that did not prevent me from committing what You know of my evil ways

Arabic text: فَمَنْ أَجْهَلُ مِنِّيْ يَا إِلَهِيْ بِرُشْدِهِ
Translation: So who is more ignorant than I am, O my God, about what is good for him?
And who is more heedless than I am about his own portion?

Arabic text: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ مِنِّيْ مِنِ اسْتِصْلَاحِ نَفْسِهِ
Translation: And who is further than I am from reforming himself?

Arabic text: حِيْنَ أُنْفِقُ مَا أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
Translation: When I spend what You have provided for me from Your sustenance
In what You have forbidden me from doing
And who is deeper in falsehood
And more daring in evil than I am?

Arabic text: حِيْنَ أَقِفُ بَيْنَ دَعْوَتِكَ وَدَعْوَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ
Translation: When I stand between Your call and the call of Satan

Arabic text: فَأَتَّبِعُ دَعْوَتَهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ عَمًى مِنِّيْ فِيْ مَعْرِفَةٍ بِهِ
Translation: And follow his call without being blind to knowledge of him
Or forgetful of his remembrance
And I am at that moment certain

Arabic text: بِأَنَّ مُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِكَ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِهِ إِلَى النَّارِ
Translation: That Your call leads to Paradise and his call leads to Hellfire

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَعْجَبَ مَا أَشْهَدُ بِهِ
Translation: Glory be to You! How amazing is what I testify against

Arabic text: عَلَى نَفْسِيْ وَأُعَدِّدُهُ مِنْ مَكْتُومِ أَمْرِي
Translation: Myself, and recount of the hidden matters of my affairs
And more amazing than that is Your patience with me
And Your slowness in hastening my punishment
That is not because I am worthy in Your sight
But because of Your patience toward me
And Your favor upon me
So that I may refrain from Your anger-causing disobedience
And abandon my worn-out evils

Arabic text: وَلِأَنَّ عَفْوَكَ عَنِّيْ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِي
Translation: And because Your pardon for me is more beloved to You than punishing me

Arabic text: بَلْ أَنَا يَا إِلَهِيْ أَكْثَرُ ذُنُوبًا
Translation: Rather, O my God, I am greater in sins
And more disgraceful in misdeeds
And more hideous in actions
And more reckless in rushing into falsehood
And weaker in wakefulness for Your obedience
And less attentive and watchful of Your warnings
Than that I could count my faults for You
Or have the ability to mention my sins

Arabic text: وَإِنَّمَا أُوَبِّخُ بِهَذَا نَفْسِيْ طَمَعًا فِيْ رَأْفَتِكَ
Translation: I only rebuke myself in hope for Your tenderness
By which the affairs of sinners are set right

Arabic text: وَرَجَاءً لِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِيْ بِهَا فَكَاكُ رِقَابِ الْخَاطِئِينَ
Translation: And in hope for Your mercy by which the necks of wrongdoers are freed

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَهٰذِهِ رَقَبَتِيْ قَدْ أَرَقَّتْهَا الذُّنُوبُ
Translation: O Allah, this is my neck, enslaved by sins

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَأَعْتِقْهَا بِعَفْوِكَ
Translation: So bless Muhammad and his family, and free it by Your pardon
And this is my back, burdened by mistakes

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَخَفِّفْ عَنْهُ بِمَنِّكَ
Translation: So bless Muhammad and his family, and lighten it with Your grace

Arabic text: يَا إِلَهِيْ لَوْ بَكَيْتُ إِلَيْكَ حَتَّى تَسْقُطَ أَشْفَارُ عَيْنَيَّ
Translation: O my God, if I were to weep to You until my eyelashes fall off
And wail until my voice is cut off
And stand for You until my feet swell
And bow to You until my backbone is dislocated
And prostrate to You until my eyeballs bulge out
And eat the dirt of the earth all my life
And drink the water of ashes till the end of my days

Arabic text: وَذَكَرْتُكَ فِيْ خِلَالِ ذٰلِكَ حَتَّى يَكِلَّ لِسَانِي
Translation: And remember You throughout all that until my tongue tires

Arabic text: ثُمَّ لَمْ أَرْفَعْ طَرْفِيْ إِلَى آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ اسْتِحْيَاءً مِنْكَ
Translation: Then never raise my glance to the horizons of the sky out of shame before You

Arabic text: مَا اسْتَوْجَبْتُ بِذٰلِكَ مَحْوَ سَيِّئَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتِي
Translation: I would not deserve by that the erasure of a single one of my evil deeds

Arabic text: وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَغْفِرُ لِيْ حِيْنَ أَسْتَوْجِبُ مَغْفِرَتَكَ
Translation: And if You forgive me when I deserve Your forgiveness
And pardon me when I merit Your pardon

Arabic text: فَإِنَّ ذٰلِكَ غَيْرُ وَاجِبٍ لِيْ بِاسْتِحْقَاقٍ
Translation: That would not be because I deserve it by right
Nor am I worthy of it by merit

Arabic text: إِذْ كَانَ جَزَائِيْ مِنْكَ فِيْ أَوَّلِ مَا عَصَيْتُكَ النَّارَ
Translation: For my recompense from You, from the first of my disobedience, was the Fire

Arabic text: فَإِنْ تُعَذِّبْنِيْ فَأَنْتَ غَيْرُ ظَالِمٍ لِي
Translation: So if You punish me, You are not unjust to me

Arabic text: إِلَهِيْ فَإِذْ قَدْ تَغَمَّدْتَنِيْ بِسِتْرِكَ فَلَمْ تَفْضَحْنِي
Translation: My God, since You have covered me with Your veil and not exposed me
And been patient with me through Your generosity and not hastened my punishment

Arabic text: وَحَلُمْتَ عَنِّيْ بِتَفَضُّلِكَ فَلَمْ تُغَيِّرْ نِعْمَتَكَ عَلَيَّ
Translation: And shown clemency toward me through Your favor and not changed Your blessing upon me
And not sullied Your goodness toward me

Arabic text: فَارْحَمْ طُولَ تَضَرُّعِيْ وَشِدَّةَ مَسْكَنَتِيْ وَسُوءَ مَوْقِفِي
Translation: Have mercy on my prolonged beseeching, intense neediness, and wretched position

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family
And protect me from sins
And employ me in obedience
And grant me goodly repentance
And purify me through penitence
And support me with infallibility
And correct me with well-being
And let me taste the sweetness of forgiveness
And make me one freed by Your pardon
And one emancipated by Your mercy
And write for me security from Your wrath

Arabic text: وَبَشِّرْنِيْ بِذٰلِكَ فِيْ الْعَاجِلِ دُوْنَ الْآجِلِ
Translation: And give me glad tidings of that in this world, not in the hereafter
Glad tidings I can recognize
And make known to me a sign of it that I can clearly see

Arabic text: إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَا يَضِيقُ عَلَيْكَ فِيْ وُسْعِكَ
Translation: Surely that is not difficult for You in Your vastness
And is not taxing on Your power
And is not hard on Your patience

Arabic text: وَلَا يَؤُودُكَ فِيْ جَزِيلِ هِبَاتِكَ الَّتِيْ دَلَّتْ عَلَيْهَا آيَاتُكَ
Translation: And does not burden You in Your abundant gifts that Your signs have indicated
Verily, You do whatever You will
And You decree what You desire
Indeed, You have power over all things
